summary.text: Ana-Maria Rodriguez Ramos, listed by Ballotpedia as Ana-Maria Ramos, is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 102 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She took office on January 8, 2019, and is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Ana-Maria Ramos was born in Dallas, Texas, according to Ballotpedia.

She earned a bachelor's degree in communication from the University of Texas at Arlington, a master's degree in business administration from Texas Woman's University and a law degree from Southern Methodist University.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney at her own law firm and as an associate professor at El Centro College.
Ramos succeeded Republican Linda Koop in District 102 and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her on the Human Services and Natural Resources committees.
She faces Republican Bonnie Abadie in the general election.
